benchmark_fixes: L8 surfaced two real transport concurrency bugs (both silent-drop class, A2.3 violations) — fixed and re-verified before the pack was recorded:
(1) outbox strand: a check-then-act race in flushOutbox left an item unsent if pushed in the window between the drain loop emptying and the flushing flag resetting; fixed with a post-drain re-check.

(2) duplicate counter / split device-id: concurrent first sends raced the lazy await-init of nextCtr and ensureDevice, yielding a duplicate ctr the receiver window drops as a replay (a silent message loss); fixed by memoizing the init reads.
Also hardened: lineage mutations (onSync/onSyncReq/appendLocal) serialized through a chain to prevent a read-modify-write race on the shared replica.
